comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Comes from new recipe that appears after you report Lighthouse of Alexandria (need to reach the deepest part of Sea of Wonders) from Ibn in Alexandria.

Recipe Name : Sewing Premium Staysails
Skill Reqs : Sewing Rank 15
Ingredients : Main Royal Staysail + 5x Strange Sail + Specially Fashioned Rope

Stats : 70/70 Durability, +25 Vertical Sail, +17 Horizontal Sail, no TS penalty.
